prototypeScope: V1.16 single print-now package: the layout F rear converter box frame and cap regenerated without the cap ears, tongues or hook (four hidden M2 x 10) and without the front passage P1 (every box wire runs outside the box), same print poses as V1.11, plus the V1.12 White increment unchanged on top of the printed V1.8 set, the V1.9 Orange plate and the released V1.11 box: colour scheme C (Shawn, 2026-10-14). One White plate: the V2.0 side shells (one M2 x 6 each down into the V1.9 pack shoulder bar, cross tunnel filled, M2 x 4 horn screws in counterbores), the two stock thighs in white (colour only) and the V1.9 head cap in white (colour only, same STL: the head stays on ROBOTIS M2.6 screws). The orange shells, thighs and V1.9 cap become spares. The V2.0 cap, lower head shell and jaw frame are deferred until the head is next opened.
knownFitBoundary: Shells need the V1.9 rear pack (its shoulder bars); Shawn confirmed it is fitted. The pack bar has no printed pilot: drill dia 1.6 through the shell roof hole with a tape flag 7.0 mm from the tip. Driver above each pack screw on the finished robot: 57.8 mm to the lower head shell. Cap: the same V1.9 cap that is on the robot, closed with the same three ROBOTIS M2.6 x 6. Thighs: same geometry as the 10/1 thighs; fitting them means taking both legs apart and re-reading the joint zeros (guide/firmware/mac/pose_snapshot.py).
processOverrideReason: PLAN-V1.12.md section C (the rough crown Shawn sanded on the V1.9 cap is its outer dome printed on support interface). The cap keeps the V1.9 roof-down pose, so the crown band still prints on single-material support (the club X1C has an AMS but no support material, Shawn 2026-10-14). The White donor profiles print that interface coarser than the V1.9 Orange files: 2 interface layers at 0.5 mm spacing and 80 mm/s, bridges at 50 mm/s. These overrides carry the V1.9 Orange values (3 layers, 0.15 mm spacing, top z gap 0.2 mm, interface 40 mm/s, bridges 30 mm/s) and turn on support ironing at the donor default flow (10 %) and spacing (0.15 mm), which reprints the top interface layer smooth. Elegoo: support_ironing is set next to enable_support_ironing, and support_style default replaces the donor tree_hybrid to match the V1.9 slice the crown was measured on. First layer 0.2 mm (White donors 0.28) as on the V1.9 cap and the other colours: at 0.28 the cap brim filled 2.6 mm2 of the concave end of the crown strip in the first White slice. Brim: per object (rows.json objectSettings), not plate-wide.

parts.changeReason: V1.16 rear converter box frame, layout F regenerated from build_f.py (back-plate/layout-F/README.md): the V1.11 frame with the two cap-screw ear bosses and their webs removed, the front passage P1 filled (solid front plate) and no tooth slots or hook notch (Shawn 2026-10-15: the cap is held by screws only). Everything else is the V1.11 frame: cover outline, four cover holes and lip, wide and narrow tiers, side windows, USB-C slot, eight XL4015 bosses, four 5991 bosses, driver lanes. The two XL4015 bosses at z 38.7 and the two upper 5991 bosses now take the cap screws. Wire notch A, the top-wall front edge cut back from x -47.0 to -49.8 over y 3.2..12.4 (rear corners r 1.0), and notch B, the cover-plate top edge lowered from z 29.5 to 28.5 over the same band (floor corners r 0.5, cover lip untouched); the 7 V and 5 V pairs climb the outside of the +y wall, cross the box top, drop through notch A into the box front cavity and pass under the shell lip through notch B onto the cover lip into the pack. Volume 10292.8 mm3, watertight, one body (layout-F/checks.json, post_build.json).
